note: Supplementary file - NOT new blends, but a significant correction. 'Fratello Navetta' already exists on the site listing 'Discovery' (5x50) and 'Inception' (6x54). Research found NO evidence 'Inception' is a real Fratello Navetta product anywhere (halfwheel, Cigar Coop, CigarScore, Fratello's own site, retailers) - flagging it as a likely data error on the site, possibly confused with the unrelated 'Navetta Inverso' wrapper-swapped line. Meanwhile 3 genuine, real editions the site is missing were found: Atlantis, Endeavour, Enterprise. All 4 real editions (Discovery + these 3) share ONE blend and were launched together at IPCPR 2017 as regular production, each simply named after a real NASA Space Shuttle (line creator Omar de Frias is a former NASA engineer). This is NOT an annual/vintage series.
